7183.title: Direct-server startup recovery gates
7183.rootCauseOneLine: A pending direct-profile navigation stays in the WebView branch without early failure revelation; native settings controls require a later error while the launch overlay can intercept touches.
7183.proposedFix: Keep the WebView mounted and make existing device-settings navigation reachable during a stalled initial load, coordinated with splash revelation; verify in a native runtime first.
7183.caveats: Two clean-checkout state diagnostics agree and 356 mobile tests pass. No iOS runtime: exact pixels, absent logo, timing and quick-action interaction remain unverified. Repository-wide build hit an unrelated SDK/plugin build-order prerequisite. Reproduction code is inline per reports repository policy. No fix PR because full native reproduction and the regression gate are unmet.
